data.name: AccueilIntro
data.value: What would you like to do?

data.name: NouvelleReceptionAide
data.value: Record a supplier delivery and put the goods into stock.

data.name: StockAide
data.value: Quantities, weighted average cost and stock value, journal of each item.

data.name: ArticleFige
data.value: The code, stock unit and decimals cannot change after creation.

data.name: ReceptionAide
data.value: Quantities in the item's stock unit; unit cost excluding recoverable VAT, in XAF. Validation puts the goods into stock and cannot be undone.

data.name: ReceptionValidee
data.value: Receipt validated: the goods are in stock.

data.name: StockIntro
data.value: Shop stock, valued at weighted average unit cost.

data.name: AucunStock
data.value: No stock: validate a goods receipt to start.

data.name: MotDePasseRegle
data.value: Password: at least 8 characters, with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, a digit and a special character.

data.name: CaisseAide
data.value: Sell at the counter, take payment, print the receipt.

data.name: SessionsAide
data.value: Monitor tills and approve closing differences.

data.name: ClientsAide
data.value: Credit customers, limits and overdue debts.

data.name: ClotureAide
data.value: Count the cash in the drawer (float included): the difference with the expected amount is recorded and approved by a manager.

data.name: ChercherClient
data.value: Search for a customer (name or phone)

data.name: AvoirAide
data.value: The goods go back into stock. If the receipt was on credit, the debt is cancelled first; the rest is refunded to the customer.

data.name: DonneesPersonnellesAide
data.value: Only the name and phone number are kept (law no. 2024/017). The credit limit is set by the accountant.

data.name: InventairesAide
data.value: Count actual stock and correct differences.

data.name: DemarqueAide
data.value: Report breakage, theft, expired goods and wastage.

data.name: DemarqueIntro
data.value: The storekeeper reports a loss; the accountant or manager approves it (stock issue at average cost) or rejects it.

data.name: RepriseAide
data.value: Import items, codes and prices from Excel.

data.name: RepriseIntro
data.value: One row per packaging. The import is all or nothing and prepares the opening count, valued at the purchase cost in the file.

data.name: ControleReussi
data.value: Check passed: the file can be imported.

data.name: ControleErreurs
data.value: {0} error(s): fix the file and check it again.

data.name: OuvertureCreee
data.value: Opening count {0} created: count the actual stock.

data.name: FreinteAide
data.value: Negative difference due to retail sales (cutting or weighing loss)

data.name: AucunArticleACompter
data.value: No items: scan an item to add it.

data.name: InventaireAide
data.value: Each scan adds the packaging content to the counted quantity. Expected stock is read when each row is counted.

data.name: InventaireValide
data.value: Count approved: stock has been corrected.

data.name: FraisAide
data.value: Transport, transit, customs: allocated to the lines by value (or quantity), they are included in the landed cost on approval.

data.name: FraisTardifsAide
data.value: A cost added now revalues the stock still on hand; the share of goods already sold remains unallocated.

data.name: DettesAide
data.value: Amounts owed to suppliers, partial payments.

data.name: DettesIntro
data.value: Each approved goods receipt creates a debt: goods and landed costs. Payments are entered on the goods receipt.

data.name: RapportsAide
data.value: Sales and margin, stock, receivables and debts, till.

data.name: FraisNonIncorporesAide
data.value: Landed costs received after the goods were sold: they could not be added to the stock cost.

data.name: ExportsAide
data.value: Journals for the accountant, in Excel or CSV.

data.name: ExportsIntro
data.value: Amounts rounded to the franc, Douala time, headings in the interface language.

data.name: JournalAide.ventes
data.value: Receipts of the period; credit notes are negative.

data.name: JournalAide.achats
data.value: Approved goods receipts, late costs, supplier payments and cancellations.

data.name: JournalAide.encaissements
data.value: Money received or refunded: non-credit payments (cash less change) and credit repayments.

data.name: JournalAide.creances
data.value: Credit sales, repayments and cancellations, with due date.

data.name: JournalAide.valeur-stock
data.value: Quantity, average cost and value of each item, on the export date.

data.name: MatriculeFige
data.value: The employee number is the sign-in name and appears on every document: it cannot change.

data.name: MotDePasseProvisoireAide
data.value: The employee must change it when first signing in.

data.name: MotDePasseProvisoireEnAttente
data.value: Temporary password: the employee has not changed it yet.

data.name: DesactivationAide
data.value: An employee leaves: they can no longer sign in or approve; their account and records are kept.

data.name: ReactivationAide
data.value: The account is deactivated. Reactivating it restores the employee's access.

data.name: ReinitialisationAide
data.value: Set a temporary password and give it to the employee: they must change it at the next sign-in. Their open sessions are closed.

data.name: FicheParAdministrateur
data.value: To correct your details or roles, contact the administrator.

data.name: ChangerMotDePasseObligatoire
data.value: Your password is temporary: choose a new one to continue.

data.name: ConfirmationDifferente
data.value: The confirmation does not match the new password.

data.name: ScanOuRecherche
data.value: Scan a code or search for an item

data.name: ConfirmerAnnulationVente
data.value: Empty the basket and cancel this sale?

data.name: VenteRapideAide
data.value: Shown as a tile at the till (items without a barcode, sold by weight…)

data.name: VenteRapideAjoutee
data.value: Added to the till's quick items.

data.name: VenteRapideRetiree
data.value: Removed from the till's quick items.

data.name: PosteOccupePar
data.value: This till is in use by {0}'s session, opened on {1}. Ask them to close it, or ask the manager to close it on their behalf (Till sessions).

data.name: CloturerAPlaceAide
data.value: Session opened on {0} and left open. Count the drawer: the closing is recorded in your name, and the difference still has to be approved.

data.name: SessionClotureeAPlace
data.value: {1}'s session on {0} closed; difference: {2}. The till is free.

data.name: HorsLigneBandeau
data.value: Offline: the server is not responding. The till keeps selling; its operations will be sent as soon as the network is back.

data.name: OuvertureHorsLigne
data.value: Server unreachable: opening a session needs the server. A session already open on this till carries on offline.

data.name: CodeInconnuHorsLigne
data.value: Code unknown on this till: {0}. The till's data dates from the last connection.

data.name: RemiseHorsLigne
data.value: Offline, a discount or a manager approval is not possible: remove the discount or wait for the network.

data.name: RenduSansEspeces
data.value: Only cash gives change: reduce the amount paid by card or Mobile Money.

data.name: ReferenceMobileMoney
data.value: The Mobile Money transaction reference is required.

data.name: PlafondHorsLigne
data.value: Offline, a credit sale must stay within the customer's limit (last known balance, pending credit included).

data.name: ClotureAttendSynchro
data.value: Cannot close: {0} operation(s) made offline have not yet been sent to the server.

data.name: RemboursementEnAttente
data.value: Repayment of {0} from {1} recorded on this till: it will be sent when the network is back.

data.name: OperationsEnAttente
data.value: {0} operation(s) made offline waiting to be sent: they will go in order as soon as the server responds.

data.name: SynchroBloquee
data.value: They belong to cashier {0}: they must sign in on this till to send them.

data.name: TicketHorsPoste
data.value: Receipt not found on this till: offline, only the current session's receipts are available.

data.name: AvoirCreditEnLigne
data.value: This receipt has a credit part: its credit note needs the server (debt to cancel).

data.name: QuantiteARendreInvalide
data.value: Enter a quantity to return, no more than what is left to return.

data.name: AnomaliesAide
data.value: Differences found when an operation made offline reaches the server: it was recorded as it happened, never refused. The manager checks and notes what was done.

data.name: AnomalieAide.NumeroManquant
data.value: Some receipts from this till never arrived: check the till's paper receipts.

data.name: AnomalieAide.NumeroReattribue
data.value: The till's number was already taken: the printed receipt shows another number than the recorded receipt.

data.name: AnomalieAide.PrixDifferent
data.value: The till sold at another price than today's (old till data): the price paid stands.

data.name: AnomalieAide.PlafondDepasse
data.value: The credit sale exceeds the customer's limit, known only at synchronisation.

data.name: AnomalieAide.SessionCloturee
data.value: The operation arrived after its session was closed: that session's cash difference needs reviewing.

data.name: AnomalieAide.DateCorrigee
data.value: The till's clock was wrong (before opening or in the future): it was brought back within the session.

data.name: ControlesAide
data.value: Every night at 2 am, every stock balance and customer debt is compared with its journal. The journal is authoritative: a discrepancy is fixed by rebuilding the balance, never by writing a movement.

data.name: ConfirmerReconstruction
data.value: Rebuild the balances of “{0}” from the journal? The journal is authoritative; no movement will be written.

data.name: SauvegardesAide
data.value: A full backup every hour to the external disk, and an encrypted copy every day outside the shop.

data.name: SauvegardeLocaleEnRetard
data.value: More than 2 hours without a backup: check the external disk and the backup container.

data.name: SauvegardeHorsSiteEnRetard
data.value: More than 26 hours without a copy: check the Internet connection and the online storage settings.

data.name: RestaurationAide
data.value: A restore replaces the database and files with a backup: it is done on the server PC, with the application stopped, using the restaurer.sh script (procedure in docs/exploitation.md). An off-site copy can only be read with the owner's private key.

data.name: ConfirmerValidationInventaire
data.value: Validate stock count {0}? Each difference becomes a stock movement; the count can no longer be changed.

data.name: ConfirmerAnnulationInventaire
data.value: Cancel stock count {0}? Its counts will be discarded.

data.name: ConfirmerValidationReception
data.value: Validate the receipt? The goods enter stock and the supplier debt is created; the receipt can no longer be changed.

data.name: ConfirmerAnnulationPaiement
data.value: Cancel this payment? An opposite payment will be recorded; the original stays in the journal.

data.name: ConfirmerValidationEcart
data.value: Validate the difference of this session? The session can no longer be changed.

data.name: ConfirmerAvoir
data.value: Issue a credit note on ticket {0}? The amount is refunded to the customer and the goods return to stock.

data.name: ConfirmerReinitialisation
data.value: Give {0} a temporary password? Their current password will stop working.

data.name: ConfirmerDesactivationCompte
data.value: Deactivate {0}'s account? They will no longer be able to sign in; nothing is deleted.

data.name: ConfirmerDesactivationCode
data.value: Deactivate this barcode? It will no longer be recognised when scanned.

data.name: ConfirmerValidationDemarque
data.value: Validate this write-off? The goods leave stock at average cost.

data.name: ConfirmerRefusDemarque
data.value: Refuse this write-off? Stock does not change.

data.name: ListeTronquee
data.value: Only the first {0} results are shown: refine your search.

data.name: GuideStyleIntro
data.value: Design system tokens and components, to check how the application looks.

data.name: GuideExempleTexte
data.value: Body text: management screens are dense, figures are aligned.

data.name: GuideDialogueExemple
data.value: Confirm this sample action? Nothing is sent to the server.
